name: Shin Koihime † Eiyuutan 4 ~Otome Enran ☆ Sangokushi Engi [Go]~
original_name: 真・恋姫†英雄譚4～乙女艶乱☆三国志演義［呉］～
source:
Sonsaku has finally achieved the ambition of her mother, Sonken.

The three kingdoms of Go, Shoku, and Gi formed a strong alliance, and peace finally came to this turbulent continent.

However, the world of peace seems a little too boring for Sonsaku the Little Conqueror ―――

[Translated from the [url=http://baseson.nexton-net.jp/eiyu4/]official website[/url]]
translation:
尊作终于实现了母亲尊肯的抱负。

戈、食、岐三个王国结成了强大的联盟，和平终于降临到了这片动荡的大陆上。

然而，和平的世界对于小征服者孙作来说似乎有点太无聊了————

[翻译自[url=http://baseson.nexton-net.jp/eiyu4/]官网[/url]]
